title: highlight.created payload v1
description: The learner created a highlight anchored to a range of one textbook block's plaintext (a single block only in v0.2.0; the plaintext rule itself is the SDK-defined block plaintext, issue #55). The anchor selector follows the W3C Web Annotation Data Model (TextQuoteSelector + TextPositionSelector). This schema checks shape only: JSON Schema cannot compare start and end, so that (and any later match against the block's actual text) is checked by harness.core.highlight (issue #34/#60).

prefix.description: A short run of text before the quote, for disambiguation.

suffix.description: A short run of text after the quote, for disambiguation.

text_position_selector.title: TextPositionSelector
text_position_selector.description: Character offsets into the block's plaintext. start < end is checked by harness.core.highlight, not this schema.

anchor.title: Highlight anchor
anchor.description: v0.2.0: one textbook block only. selector is always [TextQuoteSelector, TextPositionSelector], in that order.
